summary.text: Jack Williams is a Republican candidate for the Vermont State Senate, Windsor District (three seats), in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the August 11, 2026 Republican primary.
Ballotpedia lists him as a U.S. Army veteran who served from 1967 to 1987 and as an engineer and licensed commercial pilot.

paragraphs.text: Jack Williams was born in Telluride, Colorado, according to Ballotpedia.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1967 to 1987 and earned an associate degree from Fayetteville Technical Community College in 1989.
His career experience includes working as an engineer and licensed commercial pilot, and he has been affiliated with the American Legion.
Williams has run for the Windsor District Senate seat several times as a Republican, appearing on the general election ballot in 2016, 2018, 2020 and 2024.
In 2024 he advanced from the August 13 Republican primary and received 12.1 percent of the vote in the general election for three seats.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Williams described himself as a fiscal conservative who values strong families, work ethic, honesty and integrity.

He listed state revenue and tax rates, the state budget, crime and drug use, homelessness, election integrity, gun rights, land use and energy policy among the areas of public policy he cares about most.
